The original $50k completed-split comparator lost about $14,286 on 124 trades; selecting completed splits at announcement uses future outcomes.

The 2026-10-11 filing and corporate-action audit superseded the preliminary four-trade rerun gains (+$131 / +$1,123): ASTI was a historical split reference and PALI and IBO fell below the $1 printed-price floor once missing split factors were restored. The corrected 96-case rerun leaves one primary candidate (EDBL, a shareholder-authorization event) losing about $150 over five sessions and $582 over ten; 0 of 12 ten-session brackets are positive.
The persisted fundamental_60 book scenario (four trades) predates that audit, which removed three of its four leads; read its P&L as an input-error exhibit, not a result.
Current SEC exchange maps and Yahoo history are not a contemporaneous security master; delisted names and failed exit paths are censored, not zero returns.
FINRA short interest is positioning context, not shares that can be sold; the synthetic rows carry average volume only.
Prices, EDGAR phrase hits, control samples and per-trade ledgers are local build artifacts; this feed carries counts, dates and persisted run statistics only.

Displayed quotes and depth estimate instantaneous execution costs; they do not establish broker fills, queue outcomes, latency or dynamic market impact. Account comparisons also require affirmative cached Nasdaq trading status at both times and unrestricted SSR at entry. Venue-specific order and auction eligibility still require review.
Sampled BBO is rounded to one-second boundaries. Event-level MBP-10 is used for the account study.
Continuous trading near the auctions uses different prices and times from actual auction participation. Timing differences are reported separately from spread and book depth.

Comparisons preserve the old entry selection and share sizes, use a full same-session cover where displayed depth fits, and retain assumed borrowing. The previous volume-cap model delayed part of six covers; its different exit-path P&L is recorded separately. This study does not replay margin or prove an approved locate.
Missing exit books and insufficient exit depth remain disclosed. Complete-pair subsets are not a full-account net-profit estimate.
Additional 5/10/25bp slippage per side is an uncalibrated latency/impact sensitivity; zero-extra-cost estimates only the displayed static book.

Latency diagnostics compare displayed execution-price changes after 10/100/500ms, using the same quantities on both legs. They measure market movement without our orders and do not estimate our causal market impact, broker latency distribution or guaranteed delayed fills.

definitions.gross: Shares × entry midpoint for quote scenarios; opening auction price for descriptive price cohorts. Gross exposure counts one side, not entry-plus-exit turnover.
definitions.margin: Equity required, excluding encumbered short-sale proceeds. Greater of 50% of market exposure, FINRA per-share maintenance floors and the selected house fraction. Historical broker-specific requirements are not supplied.
definitions.aggregation: Account scenario returns divide summed P&L by summed entry exposure or margin. Capital is reused across dates: this is not a portfolio annual return or P&L divided by peak capital. Peak simultaneous entry capital is shown separately.
definitions.costs: Cost fractions are positive amounts consumed. Subtract spread, depth, timing changes, borrow and commissions from gross price P&L; timing can be negative.
definitions.tail: Historical VaR is a sample loss percentile; expected shortfall is the average of the worst ceil(5% × n) observations. 99% estimates require at least 100 observations. Stress scenarios have no assigned probability.
definitions.intraday: Listing-venue regular-session minute highs. Full entry/exit minute extremes are conservative bounds and can fall just outside the actual position window. Interior-minute results omit those boundary minutes. Prices are marks, not observed size-adjusted cover fills.

definitions.ROG: Net P&L divided by summed one-sided opening gross exposure; equal-weighted per-event means are separate.
definitions.issuer: Issuer counts use SEC company identifiers where available and otherwise unresolved symbol keys. Symbol-only keys are not proof of independent legal issuers.
definitions.ROM: Net P&L divided by summed modeled entry equity requirements, excluding encumbered short proceeds and retaining FINRA floors.
definitions.CAGR: Ending account equity / $50,000, raised to 365.25 / calendar days, minus one. No external cash flows; sizing compounds with equity; idle sessions included.
definitions.Sharpe: Daily account return mean / sample standard deviation × sqrt(252), including idle sessions. Main risk-free and cash interest assumptions are zero; constant 4% alternative and HAC-adjusted ratio are sensitivities.
definitions.Sortino: Daily excess return mean / RMS downside deviation × sqrt(252); zero minimum acceptable return.
definitions.Calmar: Full-period CAGR / absolute full-period maximum closing drawdown; a separate trailing 36-month version uses that window for both quantities.
definitions.intraday: One-second tradable quote ask marks; missing quotes and known halts use only already completed minute trade closes (quote marks for recovered events). Displayed marks exclude quantity-dependent liquidation impact.
definitions.quote_state: Only completed sampling intervals are available. Valid unchanged quotes persist within the session until updated or invalidated; they do not expire merely because no interval record was printed. This assumes no unflagged missing venue updates.
definitions.capacity: 0.1% of verified split-adjusted venue volume in the preceding 20 exchange sessions, divided by 20. Unobserved volume adds no verified capacity; this is a conservative lower bound, not a claim of zero trading or consolidated US ADV.
definitions.execution: Up to 15 distinct exchange feeds where their dated history is available. Delayed event-level depth uses the initial venue set; other feeds contribute sampled top quotes. Fresh mutually consistent venue states are combined; conflicting stale states are omitted. Subsecond changes between sampled quotes remain unknown. This is not full consolidated NBBO or broker fills.

limits: All performance is conditional research, not broker-confirmed historical performance. Historical locates and house margins remain unavailable.
The all-event portfolio assumes that the split was identifiable before entry when a dated event clock is absent. Known-before-entry and fixed-fundamental cohorts are separate comparisons.

Where a decision quote is missing, the full-sample accounting uses the opening benchmark as a hypothetical price proxy; availability at one second is unverified. The observed-entry comparison removes that assumption.
Missing and insufficient-depth exits are explicitly estimated; same-session completion is an assumption. These modeled positions must not be dropped or interpreted as guaranteed covers.
Observed short-sale restrictions and nontrading states prevent account admission; unknown status is retained as an assumption. The 671 standardized cost outcomes ignore these admission restrictions.

Quote stop triggers are risk checks relative to the entry-decision midpoint, at one-second intervals after entry, followed by a delayed marketable cover. They are not guaranteed native broker stop prices.
Zero ordinary same-day borrowing assumes matched settled positions and no separate pre-borrow charge. One-day fee sensitivities do not reconstruct historical stock-loan invoices.

Current-rate-cap cases use current ticker indications, with historical issuer identity and availability unverified. Their survivor-selected subset cannot establish historical borrow-filter profitability.
Historical venue observations and complete benchmark availability create selection gaps; the sample is not a census of all reverse splits.
Provider reduced-quality dates are counted. Valid-looking observations on those dates may still be incomplete; unflagged missing updates cannot be identified from a sampled quote alone.
CAGR and risk ratios depend on the declared $50k account, small position limits, maximum three names, capacity and zero cash interest. They are not annualized ROG or ROM.
Extra impact sensitivities are uncalibrated. Static displayed depth and market moves cannot identify our causal market impact.

Margin breaches and intraday insolvency are reported without assuming a successful broker liquidation. A case with such a breach is an unconstrained conditional equity path, not an executable funded result.
Empirical cost donors require sufficient observed depth. Unavailable liquidity and historical approval failures are not identified by a matched average or cost percentile.
Retrospective warmup donors and explored history do not provide an untouched validation cohort. No automatically optimized strategy is promoted.

borrow_economics.basis: Source-backed dated broker statements replace scenario fees on their effective dates. Quotes remain quoted economics; public indications never confer approval. Unsupplied dates retain explicit sensitivity assumptions.

protocol.entry: Next exchange session after a verified reverse split, at the open; action public before entry. Skip observed SSR rather than delay. Unknown status fails the executable gate.
protocol.exit: Same session close. Record partial fills, recalls and delayed exits; keep liabilities until a sourced cover and broker loan return. No assumed stop fill.
protocol.approval: Require dated security identity, margin schedule, written thesis, entry quote, approved locate reference, quantity and quoted annual fee. Public inventory is an indication only.
protocol.costs: One minimum borrowing day on rounded collateral; replace assumptions with dated broker fees when supplied. Entry spread, slippage and commission plus an equal exit-cost estimate must total no more than 1% of notional. Record actual fees and covers afterward.
protocol.controls: Up to three different issuers with score >=60, score difference <=15, same current SIC division, prior nominal price within factor 2 and prior 20-session dollar volume within factor 3. Exclude known reverse-split dates within 30 calendar days. Sort by pre-entry distance then ticker. Matching never uses future returns.
protocol.review: First review after at least 100 completed events and 60 issuers, with complete cost/exit records; descriptive interim updates only. Rules change only in a new version/cohort. This threshold is a review gate, not proof of representativeness.

validation.costs_basis: Imported actual fills, borrow paid and commissions; spread/slippage embedded in fills. Locate reference required. Loan settlement separately audited.

forward_status.limits: Enrollment is not an approved trade. Price benchmarks, broker approvals and actual settlements must be supplied. Missing observations do not become zero-return results.

process.hypothesis: A newly announced reverse split can expose financing or operating impairment. Short only when filed deterioration, an equity valuation gap and a near-term catalyst align, and borrow and joint squeeze risk are affordable.

gates.label: Point-in-time fundamentals
gates.requires: Raw filing-availability-filtered SSI score of at least 60, three numeric signals, an operating-company profile and a latest period no more than 200 days old

gates.label: Fresh verified announcement
gates.requires: Substantive parsed announcement no more than seven calendar days old, before any known effective split; accession, ratio, identity and schedule reconciled by the reviewer

gates.label: Six evidence lenses
gates.requires: All six lenses reviewed with dated primary evidence, a locator, the mechanism, contrary evidence and a falsifier; two impairment lenses supported including cash/financing or operating impairment; valuation and catalyst supported; no contradicted lens

gates.label: Net payoff and carry
gates.requires: At least 30% gross downside to a reachable common-equity target, at least 20% after round-trip costs and seven-day carry, carry no more than 10% of notional

gates.label: Catalyst within hold window
gates.requires: A dated catalyst within seven calendar days and before a known split; exit after five sessions

gates.label: Fresh quote and locate
gates.requires: Executable quote within 15 minutes, approved locate within four hours with fee, size and reference, and an SSR execution check

gates.label: Shared-account survival
gates.requires: Notional of at least $100; all-account stressed margin and existing sleeve loss reconciled; three-name and joint squeeze limits

gates.label: Prospective decision
gates.requires: Evidence date equals the current Eastern date; historical reviews are tagged retrospective and excluded from forward validation

policy.entry: Review a substantive announcement within seven calendar days. Enter only after all gates pass and a fresh locate and executable quote are recorded. Paper entry is a plan; it is not an order or a simulated fill. Expired announcements require a new independently sourced event.
policy.exit: Cover after five sessions including entry, before a known split effective date, or when the catalyst resolves, the falsifier occurs or borrow is recalled. A 50% adverse price move triggers a cover instruction at the next executable opportunity; gaps and halts can exceed the loss budget. Never average into a losing short.
policy.selection: Raw as-of score ≥60, at least three numeric signals, latest period ≤200 days old. Review all six lenses; at least two of the first four must be supported, including cash/financing or operating impairment. Valuation and catalyst/path must both be supported. Contradicted lenses block entry.
policy.sizing: Whole shares limited by a 0.5% equity name loss budget under a +200% price shock, stressed carry and costs; 2% joint sleeve loss, three names, 2.5% notional, 0.1% prior 20-session ADV, locate size and stressed margin with a 20% equity buffer. These are chosen research limits, not guaranteed maximum losses.
policy.payoff: Require ≥30% gross valuation downside and ≥20% after entered round-trip costs and seven-day carry, with carry ≤10% of notional. Stress carry at triple the quoted fee and collateral at triple the entry price. Target value must be plausibly attainable within the five-session catalyst window.

validation: Freeze this version before collecting future outcomes; log every lead, pass and review, including missing data and unavailable borrow.
Use actual paper fill observations and daily marked equity after all costs; a ready decision is not performance. Preserve deposits/withdrawals separately to calculate time-weighted returns.
Compare split-only, fundamentals-only and combined portfolios using the same eligible point-in-time universe and capital rules. Current historical examples remain exploratory.

Report net TWR, drawdown, expected shortfall, worst issuer, carry drag, fill/locate rejection rate, uncertainty clustered by issuer and calendar, and incremental whole-portfolio drawdown and risk. No Sharpe is available until a valid daily equity series exists.
At 30 closed paper trades across ≥20 issuers and ≥6 months, review evidence rather than automatically approve deployment. Keep a later untouched cohort and disclose every version change.

decisions_summary.note: Append-only, hash-chained reviews and passes. A paper_ready row is a plan, not an order or a fill.

definitions.conviction: 0–100 evidence rating: 60% filing-based deterioration and 40% documented framework support. Complete dated framework reviews are required for full conviction; the screen alone is provisional and is never a probability.
definitions.gross_edge: Mean same-policy short return from up to 60 other issuers whose trades had closed before this announcement. Nearest frozen fundamental score and announced ratio; full framework ratings and economic dilution matched only where documented for both issuers. Minimum 20 prior issuers.
definitions.net_edge: Gross expected return minus forecast round-trip spread/depth, commissions and probability-weighted holding-period borrow. All figures are fractions of opening gross exposure; expected cost forecasts use prior completed issuers only.
definitions.skewness: Third standardized central moment of the estimated short-return distribution. Positive values describe a right tail for short P&L. Gain/loss ratio is expected positive payoff divided by expected negative payoff, including their frequencies.
definitions.sizing: Quarter mean/second-moment sizing multiplied by evidence rating, capped at 2.5% notional and 0.5% equity loss under a +200% squeeze with triple-rate carry on triple-price collateral plus costs; then whole shares, 0.1% prior volume, three names, 2% sleeve stress and 60% entry-margin budget. Negative net edge receives zero size. Stops are triggers, not maximum losses.
definitions.borrow: Sum each scenario's settled calendar-day collateral × annual rate / 360, then average scenarios. US collateral is shares × ceil(1.02 × price). T+2 before May 28, 2024; T+1 thereafter. Weekends and exchange holidays enter through settlement dates. Same-day ordinary carry is zero under matched settlement; one billed day is a separate pre-borrow sensitivity. No hourly APR proration.
definitions.dilution: Reverse-split mechanical dilution is zero. Dated issuance, warrants and converts require reconciled share counts and net proceeds to common. Missing financing evidence stays unknown; no automatic dilution return is added to empirical gross edge.

limits: The frozen sample contains completed and priced splits. It is a conditional replay and cannot establish an announcement-universe strategy; cancelled, failed and unpriced announcements require a separate full-universe cohort.
Current history has no complete dated framework packages or approved historical locates. Full-framework results remain blocked; screen-only cases use explicitly assumed borrowing access and rates.

Announcement time is the existing conservative availability clock. Same-day date-only filings are omitted. Current SEC industry metadata is excluded from numeric ratings; the strict case requires a dated operating-profile review. Security aliases and class identity still need historical reconciliation.
The historical framework and dilution gaps are not filled with today's research. No claimed incremental return from qualitative frameworks or actual dilution exists until dated evidence is imported.

Payoff donors and cost donors contain only earlier exits from other issuers. This history has been explored already; these are walk-forward estimates, not untouched validation or calibrated probabilities.

Only intraday execution paths are replayed: close, 60 minutes, and 10% profit take / 20% adverse trigger / close. Multi-day carry is supported by the accrual engine but multi-day performance is not claimed.

Forecast collateral is held at the announcement's nominal-price projection. One-day realized fee sensitivity uses the entry mark; these are assumptions rather than reconstructed broker invoices. Daily price/rate scenarios are supported by the carry engine.

Missing/depth-limited fills use prior-issuer cost forecasts and remain in P&L. Stops may gap, halts may delay cover, and unobserved covers remain estimated. Closing drawdown omits intraday margin breaches; all results are conditional on funding and eventual cover.
Small risk limits and commission minima can exclude otherwise positive expected-value names. No live capital, orders, or production RSI-1.0 thresholds change.
